title: Tambur tambur (Anonymous)
desc: Anonymous, Tambur tambur. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Cortona 95-96, Paris 11v. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ano3002); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
